task.title: 修复 git-flow 本地门禁漏口与 Squash worktree 清理及文档对齐
task.description: 收口 4 项 git-flow 错落：①check-secrets --pre-push 新分支无 upstream 时回退对比 origin/main merge-base（修复仅 diff 工作区漏扫未推提交）；②git-guard 移除与并发契约冲突的 maybeAutoBump、行尾换行改读暂存区 blob、补齐产物路径模式与保护分支/tag 删除拦截；③新增 git-prune-worktrees.mjs 安全清理已 Squash 合并 worktree；④同步 AGENTS.md / git-flow SKILL / PR 模板 / release.mjs / verify 口径。

evidence: check-secrets --pre-push fallback, git-guard staged-blob/delete/no-auto-bump, git-prune-worktrees + selftest, backlog cross-batch lease guard, observability gate symlink guard + C5 conformance, docs & verify sync; all specs and gates PASS
